text:
nina: Heads-up 1 deployed QuietPack v1.1 to canary last night. Short summary: p99 down ~16% for short-chat flows, p95 down ~8%, cost per token -9% on sampled traffic.

rahim: awesome. what are the mechanics?

nina: two small changes: adaptive jitter smoothing to collapse microbursts, plus a tiny hold-window (8ms) when subsequent chunks are predicted. Both change batching behavior to favor slightly larger GPU invocations.

simone: any customer-visible regressions?

nina: p50 unchanged, occasional +1-3ms on very short single-turn calls under light load. No error uptick.

deploy-bot: QuietPack v1.1 -> canary cluster (canary-21) SUCCESS at 2025-01-12T04:12:01Z

rahim: config snippet for ops?

nina: paste: 

pack_mode: quiet_pack
adaptive_jitter_ms: 5
hold_window_ms: 8
bypass_seq_len: 2048

simone: where are the dashboards?

nina: https://internal.redwood/dashboard/quietpack/canary-21. Key panels: pack_size_by_route, hold_window_hits, p99_vs_baseline, cost_delta.

rahim: rollout plan?

nina: 10% eu-west -> 30% -> 60% over 4 days. Auto-rollback if p99 regresses >5% absolute or errors >0.5% sustained 10m.

simone: can we add trace fields for pack_size and hold_flag?

nina: opened PR #5010 to add span attrs: pack_size, hold_wait_ms, bypass_flag. Landing today.

rahim: please add a short note to #announcements and CN for product.

nina: will post a blurb and attach the dashboard slice after 24h of eu-west run.

simone: nice work team :tada:
